batchName: Live Scout truck evidence collection batch 3
rules: Evidence only; do not mutate production records from this artifact.
Do not invent logos, covers, menus, schedules, social links, or descriptions.
Do not treat third-party listings or social snippets as owner-approved menu data unless doctrine later explicitly allows it.

Classify schedule evidence as current_week_only only when the source is dated/current, recurring only when the source clearly describes a repeating stop, and needs_owner_confirmation when plausible but ambiguous.
Run manual truck intake in dry-run mode before any apply operation.
Keep ownerApprovalNeeded true until owner/operator review is complete.
